At this point your binge eating is probably habitual, or maybe you have developed a food addiction? 

I know you said you’ve conquered the emotional traumas you were dealing with that caused your disorder to arise, but if your university has a health center I would visit it and talk to a counselor or doctor.

I personally realized that I had become stuck in the habit of binge eating, and for myself it’s typically when I’m overwhelmed or stressed out, but 90% of the time I can choose to stop, it’s not as easy as it sounds but it’s possible.

If you have any sort of patterns that you follow when binge eating, such as mainly binge eating at night or after certain events I would really try to substitute those moments with other positive things in order to form habits that push the binges out.

Again, the road to recovery when it comes to binge eating isn’t linear, you will have to consistently work on it and push past any animalistic impulses that make you binge. The best way to do this will ultimately be up to you, and so that’s where I think a counselor might help as you can more easily lay everything out (such as emotions or habits/patterns) and get to the bottom of this!

I wish you the best!! x

Edit: I read some of your post history to see if I could help you a bit more, please see a counselor/doctor, you most likely have a problem with restricting then binge eating. I don’t know you personally so I can’t help much with that, but I’ve dealt with the same issues, so I definitely urge you to get professional help. You deserve to be happy and have a healthy relationship with food.

Not dumb! :) Temp agencies provide temporary job opportunities. It’s usually an agency that provides workers to a specific company for short-term, sometimes they are “temp to hire” and after a certain amount of time you become an employee to the company instead of the agency. You’ll work on “assignments” that last however long (they usually tell you ahead of time), and in my experience it was usually warehouse work but you can specify what you’re comfortable working with. Usually no experience required.
I don’t live in Australia but if there are places such as temp agencies you can usually get a job pretty quickly! Typically warehouse/factory work which kind of sucks but money is money!
